scope: Kenya CBC regular Grade 10 curriculum designs; SNE adaptations are excluded

authoritativeIndex.title: Grade Ten
authoritativeIndex.heading: Grade 10 Designs
authoritativeIndex.evidence: The current KICD page groups 39 Google Drive preview iframes under eight catalogue families. Thirty-eight iframe titles identify Grade 10 documents; the Marine and Fisheries iframe identifies Grade 11 and is quarantined.

officialSources.title: LIST OF APPROVED COURSE MATERIALS FOR GRADE 10
officialSources.note: The file is hosted in the KICD March 2026 upload path, while its internal approval date is June 2025.

sourcePolicy.currentSource: Use only a Grade 10 Drive preview embedded by the authoritative KICD index.
sourcePolicy.gradeIdentity: The exact embedded file title must identify Grade 10. A differently graded file is ineligible even when embedded on the Grade 10 index.
sourcePolicy.mirrorHandling: A KICD wp-content mirror is null unless independently verified as the same current revision.
sourcePolicy.unknownMetadata: Unverified dates, mirrors, and page counts are null; dates parsed only to the precision stated by the exact title.
sourcePolicy.blockerHandling: Expected regular learning areas without an eligible Grade 10 source remain explicit blocked catalogue entries.
sourcePolicy.captureEligibility: Reconcile the ordered 39-entry captureEligibility.manifestAssetRegistry first, then capture only entries also present in captureEligibility.slugRegistry with disposition capture_eligible. A KICD index embed is not sufficient when its exact title identifies another grade.

formalSlotModel.name: Senior School seven-learning-area structure
formalSlotModel.derivation: Four core slots and three elective slots selected through pathway, track, and coded subject combinations.
formalSlotModel.catalogueAccounting: KICD design availability, formal core/elective role, and separately timetabled activities are recorded independently.

slots.blocker: No regular Grade 10 Kenya Sign Language design is present on the authoritative KICD index.

slots.rule: Core Mathematics applies to STEM; Essential Mathematics applies to Social Sciences and Arts and Sports Science.

pathwayEvidenceLimit: The primary subject pools express the official pathway taxonomy, not every permitted supporting subject. Exact three-subject eligibility is governed by the Ministry of Education coded subject-combination register.

captureEligibility.rule: Capture is allowed only when the authoritative Grade 10 index embeds the file and the exact Drive title identifies Grade 10.
captureEligibility.slugRule: Lowercase the canonical subject name, replace each run of non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters with one hyphen, and trim leading or trailing hyphens.

subjects.subject: Core Mathematics
subjects.title: Core Mathematics Grade 10 - July 2025.pdf
subjects.aliasCaution: The Ministry subject-combination PDF uses Advanced Mathematics in some combinations, while the live portal and KICD design use Core Mathematics. The alias records the official inconsistency, not equivalence.

subjects.subject: Marine and Fisheries Technology
subjects.blocker: The only iframe in this catalogue position resolves to a Grade 11 document and is quarantined below.

quarantinedSources.title: Marine & Fisheries Technology Grade 11 - July 2025.pdf
quarantinedSources.reason: The exact current Drive title identifies Grade 11. It must not be captured, normalized, imported, or counted as a Grade 10 source.
quarantinedSources.releaseCondition: Replace this manifest position only with an official regular Grade 10 Marine and Fisheries Technology source whose authorized PDF cover and bytes pass the acquisition and identity gates.

scopeExclusions.reason: HI, PI, and VI Grade 10 designs are adaptations outside this regular-curriculum catalogue.

gaps.subject: Kenya Sign Language
gaps.description: The Ministry pathway/combination evidence and the senior-school core language alternative require Sign Language or Kenya Sign Language coverage, but the regular KICD Grade 10 index has no eligible KSL design. SNE Hearing Impairment material is not a substitute for a regular source.
gaps.releaseCondition: KICD publishes or identifies an official regular Grade 10 Kenya Sign Language design that passes authorized acquisition and cover identity validation.

gaps.subject: Marine and Fisheries Technology
gaps.description: The regular KICD Grade 10 index embeds a document titled Grade 11 in the Marine catalogue position. No valid current regular Grade 10 Marine and Fisheries document was verified.
gaps.releaseCondition: KICD supplies or identifies an official regular Grade 10 Marine and Fisheries Technology design that passes authorized acquisition and cover identity validation.

gaps.subject: Core Mathematics
gaps.description: The Ministry subject-combination PDF uses Advanced Mathematics in some coded combinations, while current KICD and live Ministry surfaces use Core Mathematics. Preserve both source labels and do not infer equivalence.

gaps.subject: Mandarin
gaps.description: KICD uses Mandarin; the Ministry combination PDF uses Mandarine Chinese. The latter is retained only as an official-source alias.
